cues: Put x equal to one in one plus x to the n: the coefficients add up to two to the n. Put x equal to minus one: the alternating sum is zero.
And in general, the sum of the coefficients of any expansion is found by putting every variable equal to one.
For two x minus three y to the twelve: minus one to the twelve, which is one.
